4. INSTALL VALVE BODY BOLTS
Install the bolts as shown. Tighten the bolts evenly.
Torque: 100 kg-cm (7 ft-lb, 10 N-m)

5. INSTALL OIL STRAINER
Be sure the strainer is clean. Torque the six bolts.
Torque: 55 kg-cm (48 in.-lb, 5.4 N-m)

6. WHEN REPLACING SOLENOID
(a) For the No. 3 solenoid,
• Install the solenoid into the bore.
• Tighten the two bolts.
Torque: 55 kg-cm (48 in.-lb, 5.4 N-m)

(b) For the No. 1 and 2 solenoids,
• Make sure that the two valve spring are installed correctly.
• Install the solenoid over the gasket and install the center of the bolt.
• Tighten the three bolts.
Torque: 100 kg-cm (7 ft-lb, 10 N-m)

7. CONNECT TWO CONNECTORS TO EACH SOLENOID
(a) Connect the two connectors to each solenoid.
(b) Clamp the solenoid wire.
